Heard Ms. R. D. Mozumdar, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellant impugning the Judgment and Award dated 18.12.2025 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 1,
Kamrup (M) in MAC Case No. 732/2018 whereby the appellant was directed to pay a compensation amount of Rs.27,81,500/- along with an interest @ 6% per annum to the respondents/claimants.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 1,
Kamrup
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I have gone through the grounds stated in the Memo of Appeal and I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.
Call for the records of MAC Case No. 732/2018 from the concerned Tribunal.
Registry to take necessary steps for requisitioning the aforesaid records.
Let notice be issued, returnable on 22.05.2026.
Let steps be taken for service of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual process.
Steps within 7 (seven) days from the date of this order.
